issue:
logic inconsistance for CTE name with column names in sqlite

I am using sqlglot to rewrite SQLite queries. However, sqlglot modifies the original query during a simple parse + serialize round trip, which introduces a semantic error before I even apply any rewrite logic.

Original query:
```
WITH xyz(x) AS (SELECT 1)
SELECT x FROM xyz;
```
I only perform parsing and serialization:
```
sql = """WITH xyz(x) AS (SELECT 1)
        SELECT x FROM xyz;"""

ast = sqlglot.parse_one(sql, read="sqlite")
print(ast.sql(dialect="sqlite"))
```
Expected output:
```
WITH xyz(x) AS (SELECT 1)
SELECT x FROM xyz;
```
Actual output:
```
WITH xyz AS (SELECT 1)
SELECT x FROM xyz;
```
The column name declaration (x) in the CTE is removed during serialization, which caused error when it was executed on sqlite.
